# Ella Verbs App

> > Comprehensive Spanish verb conjugation reference with tables for 18 tenses, interactive sudoku puzzles, and learning tools.

Ella Verbs App provides detailed conjugation tables for hundreds of Spanish verbs across all 18 tenses, including regular -ar/-ir/-er verbs, irregular verbs, and reflexive verbs. The site offers both reference materials and interactive learning tools like Spanish Verb Sudoku.

## Key Topics

- Spanish verb conjugation
- Spanish grammar
- Verb tenses
- Irregular verbs
- Reflexive verbs
- Regular -ar verbs
- Regular -ir verbs
- Spanish tenses
- Verb conjugation tables
- Language learning
- Conjugation guide
- Spanish Verb Sudoku

## Interactive Learning Tools

- [Spanish Verb Sudoku – Free Online Puzzles & Printable PDFs](https://ellaverbs.com/spanish-verb-sudoku): Interactive Spanish verb conjugation sudoku puzzles and printable PDFs

## Common Spanish Verbs
